propositions: The portable claim example currently instructs passing --assignee but should omit it to reflect that ticket.default_assignee applies automatically when the option is absent
Template guidance must specify behavior for both configured ticket.default_assignee and when it is empty, without assuming every repository uses Jira
Explicit assignee overrides require email or accountId only when the store is Jira-reconciled
The link inventory must include caused_by and plan review guidance must order prerequisite review before dependent review
The generated region in templates/AGENTS.md must byte-synchronize with templates/rebar-usage.md through the established template ownership mechanism
Repository-specific Gerrit workflow guidance must be excluded from the portable template
